title: ChatGPT Gains an Opt-In Memory of Computer Activity
summary: OpenAI’s Computer History lets ChatGPT recall recent activity across Mac apps and websites, with a 48-hour event-recording window and organization-level controls.
body:
## From conversation memory to computer memory

OpenAI has begun rolling out Computer History, an opt-in feature that allows ChatGPT to use a record of recent activity across applications and websites on a Mac. Instead of relying only on chats, uploaded files and connected services, the assistant can draw on a broader timeline of what the user has recently been doing and resume work with less repeated explanation.

The feature is launching in the ChatGPT desktop application for Mac for Pro, Business and Enterprise customers. OpenAI says availability is rolling out globally, although access in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom and Switzerland will follow later. Computer History is off by default. Pro users can enable it in the app’s Computer History settings, while Business and Enterprise users require their organization’s administrator to make it available.

Computer History builds on OpenAI’s earlier Chronicle research preview. Rather than taking screenshots or recording audio, it records interaction events from selected apps and websites. OpenAI says those raw events are stored temporarily for no more than 48 hours while they are processed into memories. Users can inspect their timeline, remove individual activity and clear associated memories. OpenAI has not presented the feature as an unlimited archive of raw computer activity; its purpose is to supply recent working context to future ChatGPT and Codex interactions.

The distinction matters because a chronological record of computer use can contain far more sensitive information than an ordinary chat history: documents opened, sites visited and fragments of work spanning multiple applications. An opt-in design, visible timeline, short raw-event retention period and deletion controls reduce some risk, but organizations will still need to decide whether the productivity gain justifies exposing this category of context to an assistant. The delayed European rollout also indicates that regional privacy and compliance requirements remain operational constraints.

## Why it matters

Computer History moves the AI assistant closer to being a persistent layer over the operating system. If it works reliably, users may no longer need to manually assemble context before delegating a task, removing one of the largest sources of friction in agent workflows. At the same time, it makes control over collection, retention and deletion a core product battleground. The companies that win personal AI may be those trusted to remember the most—not merely those with the strongest underlying model.
title_zh: ChatGPT推出电脑活动记忆，跨应用延续工作上下文
summary_zh: OpenAI在Mac端上线可选的“电脑历史”，让ChatGPT调用近期应用与网页活动；原始交互事件最多保留48小时，企业用户还受管理员控制。
body_zh:
## 从记住对话，走向记住电脑活动

OpenAI开始推送“电脑历史”（Computer History）功能。用户主动开启后，ChatGPT可以使用Mac上近期跨应用、跨网站的活动记录，不再只依赖对话、上传文件和连接器。其目标是让助手知道用户刚刚处理过什么，从而减少每次继续工作时重复交代背景的负担。

该功能首先进入Mac版ChatGPT桌面应用，面向Pro、Business和Enterprise用户。OpenAI表示正在全球推送，但欧洲经济区、英国和瑞士要等到后续阶段。“电脑历史”默认关闭。Pro用户可以在应用的“电脑历史”设置中自行开启；Business和Enterprise用户则需要所在组织的管理员先开放该功能。

“电脑历史”建立在此前Chronicle研究预览的基础上。它不会定时截取屏幕或录制音频，而是记录用户在所选应用和网站中的交互事件。OpenAI表示，这些原始事件在转化为记忆期间只会临时保存，最长不超过48小时。用户可以查看活动时间线、删除单项记录，并清除相关记忆。公司没有把该功能描述成无限期保存原始电脑活动的档案；现阶段的重点，是为后续ChatGPT与Codex交互提供近期工作背景。

这类数据与普通聊天记录存在本质差别。电脑活动时间线可能包含打开过的文件、访问过的网站，以及散落在多个应用中的工作片段，敏感程度通常更高。主动开启、可视化时间线、较短的原始事件保留期和删除功能能够降低部分风险，但企业仍需判断：节省上下文整理时间的收益，是否足以抵消向助手开放这类信息所带来的风险。欧洲地区延后上线，也说明隐私与合规要求仍会直接影响产品发布节奏。

## 为什么重要

“电脑历史”让AI助手进一步成为覆盖操作系统的持续工作层。如果它足够可靠，用户在委派任务前将不再需要手动拼装背景资料，这会消除智能体工作流中最明显的摩擦之一。与此同时，谁来收集、保留和删除这些记录，也将成为新的产品竞争核心。个人AI的赢家，未必只是底层模型最强的公司，也可能是最能让用户放心托付记忆的公司。
